title: 蘭傑礦復育工程
subcategoryTitle: 礦山復育與長期水管理
subcategoryTitleEn: Mine rehabilitation and long-term water management
summary: 以已停止採選的礦區復育為案例，聚焦地形、水文、植生與長期監測。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
summaryEn: A post-mining rehabilitation case focuses on landform, hydrology, vegetation and long-term monitoring. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 回復地形所需覆蓋材料量；季風雨量與地表逕流的體積；施工期與復育期水量邊界
v31FocusEn: Cover materials needed for landform restoration; Monsoonal rainfall and surface-runoff volumes; Water boundaries during works and rehabilitation

stages.title: 資源條件與系統邊界：蘭傑礦復育工程
stages.titleEn: Resource conditions and system boundaries: Ranger Mine rehabilitation
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「回復地形所需覆蓋材料量」與「季風雨量與地表逕流的體積」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cover materials needed for landform restoration" and "Monsoonal rainfall and surface-runoff volumes": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「回復地形所需覆蓋材料量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cover materials needed for landform restoration" is correct?
options: 覆蓋材料的需求由面積乘有效厚度得到，但壓實、坡面面積與施工損失會改變交付量。
平均覆土厚度合格就能證明每個位置都已復育成功。
知道總降雨體積就能決定排水設施的峰值容量。
optionsEn: Cover demand starts with area times effective thickness, but compaction, slope surface area and handling losses change delivered volume.
An acceptable mean cover thickness proves successful rehabilitation everywhere.
Total rainfall volume alone determines peak drainage capacity.
quiz.explanation: 覆蓋材料的需求由面積乘有效厚度得到，但壓實、坡面面積與施工損失會改變交付量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cover demand starts with area times effective thickness, but compaction, slope surface area and handling losses change delivered volume. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 回復地形所需覆蓋材料量：機制與資源流程
steps.titleEn: Cover materials needed for landform restoration: mechanism and resource flow
steps.objective: 說明「回復地形所需覆蓋材料量」如何決定「蘭傑礦復育工程」的物料、能量、量測或環境功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cover materials needed for landform restoration” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Ranger Mine rehabilitation”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 以「蘭傑礦復育工程」作案例背景，本單元的原創桌上問題是「回復地形所需覆蓋材料量」。覆蓋材料的需求由面積乘有效厚度得到，但壓實、坡面面積與施工損失會改變交付量。覆土厚度本身不證明水文或生態功能；本單元用體積守恆建立材料需求，再要求獨立的滲透與植生證據。 這是情境分析，不宣稱該工程使用下列合成數值。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Using Ranger Mine rehabilitation as the case setting, this original desk-based investigation addresses cover materials needed for landform restoration. Cover demand starts with area times effective thickness, but compaction, slope surface area and handling losses change delivered volume. Thickness alone proves neither hydrological nor ecological function. The lesson balances material volume and requires separate infiltration and vegetation evidence. This is scenario analysis and does not claim that the project uses the synthetic values below. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：以已停止採選的礦區復育為案例，聚焦地形、水文、植生與長期監測。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均覆土厚度合格就能證明每個位置都已復育成功。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

quiz.question: 依「回復地形所需覆蓋材料量」的模型 V = A·d·10000，覆土量與地形復育的合成教學算例；輸入單位：A: ha plan area; d: m effective thickness。不是該場址實測或操作值。最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model V = A·d·10000 for "Cover materials needed for landform restoration", which value is closest to the synthetic teaching example for cover volume and landform rehabilitation; input units: A: ha plan area; d: m effective thickness. These are not measured or operating values for this site.?
quiz.explanation: V = A·d·10000；代入 A = 25 ha plan area、d = 0.35 m effective thickness，得 87,500 m³（覆土量與地形復育的合成教學算例；輸入單位：A: ha plan area; d: m effective thickness。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: V = A·d·10000; with A = 25 ha plan area, d = 0.35 m effective thickness the result is 87,500 m³ (synthetic teaching example for cover volume and landform rehabilitation; input units: A: ha plan area; d: m effective thickness. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 回復地形所需覆蓋材料量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cover materials needed for landform restoration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「回復地形所需覆蓋材料量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Cover materials needed for landform restoration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：V = A·d·10000；代入 A = 25 ha plan area、d = 0.35 m effective thickness，得 87,500 m³（覆土量與地形復育的合成教學算例；輸入單位：A: ha plan area; d: m effective thickness。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 d 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: V = A·d·10000; with A = 25 ha plan area, d = 0.35 m effective thickness the result is 87,500 m³ (synthetic teaching example for cover volume and landform rehabilitation; input units: A: ha plan area; d: m effective thickness. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise d by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：d 增加 10% 時，結果變為 96,250 m³（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising d by 10% changes the result to 96,250 m³ (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 87,500 m³（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 d 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 87,500 m³ (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in d with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「回復地形所需覆蓋材料量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cover materials needed for landform restoration"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
物料帳有差額就能立即斷定有實體洩漏。
針對「回復地形所需覆蓋材料量」，用合成高程差分與材料運輸紀錄交叉核對覆土體積，將壓實前後體積分開；對坡面積與平面積作敏感度比較。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.

For cover materials needed for landform restoration, cross-check synthetic elevation differences against material-delivery records, separate loose and compacted volumes, and compare slope area with plan area in sensitivity analysis.
quiz.explanation: 針對「回復地形所需覆蓋材料量」，用合成高程差分與材料運輸紀錄交叉核對覆土體積，將壓實前後體積分開；對坡面積與平面積作敏感度比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For cover materials needed for landform restoration, cross-check synthetic elevation differences against material-delivery records, separate loose and compacted volumes, and compare slope area with plan area in sensitivity analysis. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 回復地形所需覆蓋材料量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cover materials needed for landform restoration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「回復地形所需覆蓋材料量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cover materials needed for landform restoration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「回復地形所需覆蓋材料量」，用合成高程差分與材料運輸紀錄交叉核對覆土體積，將壓實前後體積分開；對坡面積與平面積作敏感度比較。 提交控制體圖與有單位的資料表，讓另一位學徒能獨立重算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For cover materials needed for landform restoration, cross-check synthetic elevation differences against material-delivery records, separate loose and compacted volumes, and compare slope area with plan area in sensitivity analysis. Submit a control-volume diagram and a table with units so another learner can recalculate independently. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把材料數量、侵蝕穩定與生態恢復分開驗收，避免單一工程指標代替全部成效。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Accept material quantity, erosion stability and ecological recovery separately; one engineering indicator cannot represent all outcomes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在「回復地形所需覆蓋材料量」情境，材料足量但局部薄層可能來自地形誤差或分布不均；以網格厚度圖識別，不以平均厚度取代檢查。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: In the scenario of cover materials needed for landform restoration, enough material with local thin patches may reflect terrain error or uneven spreading; identify it with a thickness grid instead of relying on the mean. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 證據版本
knowledge.text: 2026-11-10：核對官方工程識別與公開情境；算例由作者設定為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: 2026-11-10: Primary project identity and public context reviewed; numerical examples are authored teaching assumptions.
